name: tow
description: Tag Ontology for Wiki: skills for a tag-first LLM wiki in Obsidian (PARA, classification fields, concept tag ontology).

interface.longDescription: Set up a vault, then search, classify, file, edit, link and reconcile local Obsidian notes. Review ownership and merge notes with per-case choices; changes follow the selected workflow’s approval rules. Requires a local vault, Python 3.10+ and Node.js 22.18+; runs the tag-ontology CLI from npm. Your agent host processes the note content you open and controls file permissions. TOW has no hosted backend.
defaultPrompt: Find my project notes about RAG.
Check these notes against the TOW conventions.
Suggest concept tags for this note.
